name: James B. Clark III
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed July 15, 2013 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 4.

biography.text: Clark earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Notre Dame and practiced as a partner at Peterpaul & Clark before joining the bench in 2013.
biography.source_note: Public secondary sources conflict on law school: one identifies St. John's University School of Law, another Seton Hall. Both are recorded; neither is adopted until an official resume resolves it.

role_line: U.S. Magistrate Judge | Appointed July 15, 2013 | Newark
